item.text:
Refactored the codebase around a clearer workflow boundary. [NaiveSearchEngine.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaiveSearchEngine.java:1) now owns the naive matching algorithm behind a new [SearchEngine.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchEngine.java:1) interface, while [SearchApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchApplication.java:1) owns argument-to-output flow.

That let me simplify [NaivePatternSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearch.java:1) into a compatibility facade, remove the duplicate formatting implementation by centralizing it in [SearchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResult.java:1), and make [NaivePatternSearchCli.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchCli.java:1) a thin entry point. I also extended [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchTest.java:1) to verify the new application layer.
